seoTitle: For Manufacturers in Tamil Nadu | Connect HF
seoDescription: Connect with qualified international buyers looking to source goods manufactured in Tamil Nadu. Apply to join our supplier network.

hero.title: Connect Your Factory with Global Procurement Buyers
hero.subtitle: We connect verified manufacturers in Tamil Nadu with international buyers looking for reliable export partners. No listing fees, no middlemen markups.

eligibility.title: Manufacturer Eligibility Criteria
eligibility.item1: Registered manufacturing facility located within Tamil Nadu, India
eligibility.item2: Valid GST, Import Export Code (IEC) and business registration documentation
eligibility.item3: Dedicated production lines and quality inspection personnel on site
eligibility.item4: Willingness to accommodate buyer visits and third-party pre-shipment inspections

form.title: Apply to Join as a Manufacturer
form.subtitle: Tell us about your production facility and manufacturing capabilities.
